Name: Visible Sprinkler Radius
Author: Dominikkovi
Description:
[b][size=4]Visible Sprinkler Radius.[/size][/b]
[size=3]A quite simple mod, that adds a visible radius to sprinklers.
By pressing R(default, changebla), you can see the already placed ones radius![/size]

[line]
[size=4][b][b]Installation[/b][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] — Make sure you have version 4.0.0 or higher.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] [i](recommended)[/i] — Allows you to change all settings from inside the game.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][b]Download and extract[/b] — Place the [i][b]RandomizedBundles[/b][/i] folder into your [b][i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i][/b] directory.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][b]Launch the game[/b] — Run through [b][i]StardewModdingAPI.exe. [/i][/b]Bundles are generated the first time you load a save.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b][b]Requirements[/b][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.0 or higher[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][line]

Manifest.Name: Visible Sprinklers
Manifest.Description: Shows a semi-transparent overlay of tiles each sprinkler will water. Hold a sprinkler to preview placement, or press the toggle key to highlight all placed sprinklers on the current map.
Manifest.Author: Axis
